plant.potted.physical: Top-down view of the potted fern: a round cream stoneware pot almost hidden under a spray of white wicker fronds.

plant.tree.physical: Top-down view of the potted palm: a square honey bentwood planter under a wide round crown of honey leaves that spills past its edges.

press.fruit.physical: Top-down view of a fruit press: a round slatted brown bentwood basket with a pressing plate and enamelled iron screw on top, a spout and bucket at the bottom edge.

press.printing.physical: Top-down view of a platen press: a grey sheet steel frame with a flat sheet steel bed sliding out toward the bottom, a long lever arm to one side, stacked paper and an ink slab along the top edge.

rack.clothing.physical: Top-down view of a clothes rail two cells wide: a straight dark green enamelled iron bar across the middle with a crowded row of hanging faded blue clothes seen from above, feet at either end.

rack.coat.physical: Top-down view of a hatstand: small round chestnut stained beech base, a central post with four hooks pointing outward, a coat draped over one side.

rack.drying.physical: Top-down view of a folding clothes horse: parallel honey varnished pine rails with blue-striped sheets and shirts draped over them.

rack.tool.physical: Top-down view of a tool rack: brown bentwood board against the top edge with sheet steel hand tools hung on a row of pegs, a narrow tray of fixings along the bottom.

rack.weapon.physical: Top-down view of a rifle rack: a thick honey bentwood rack lying along the top edge with a row of notches, three dark rifles lying in it side by side with barrels toward the top edge and stocks toward the bottom, a cast iron bar across them.

rack.wine.physical: Top-down view of a wine rack: honey bentwood lattice against the top edge, bottle necks pointing toward the bottom edge in neat rows.

radio.gramophone.physical: Top-down view of the gramophone: a square amber varnished pine cabinet with a turntable and record, a large grey sheet steel horn flaring toward the bottom.

radio.jukebox.physical: Top-down view of the jukebox: a rounded grey sheet steel cabinet, back along the top edge, a curved plate glass dome and glowing trim toward the bottom.

radio.set.physical: Top-down view of the valve radio on a small table: a honey bentwood cabinet with its back along the top edge, a dial and speaker grille toward the bottom.

religious.candle_rack.physical: Top-down view of the votive candle stand: a stepped grey sheet steel tray filled with rows of small lit candles, a sand tray at the front toward the bottom.

religious.font.physical: Top-down view of the font: a round buff york stone basin on an eight-sided base, a chestnut stained beech lid with a knob at its centre.

religious.prayer_mat.physical: Top-down view of the prayer mat: a small oblong of deep madder-red calico with a dark gold pointed arch motif at the top end and a fringe at the bottom.

rug.carpet.physical: Top-down view of a large oblong patterned carpet: cream damask centre with a central medallion, a wide maroon border, fringe along the short sides.

rug.hide.physical: Top-down view of the bearskin rug: a brown animal pelt spread flat, four legs splayed to the corners, head at the top.

rug.mat.physical: Top-down view of a small oblong rag rug: black wool serge in rough bands, frayed ends at left and right.

rug.runner.physical: Top-down view of a long narrow runner running from top to bottom: navy wool serge with a stripe down each long edge.

rug.woven.physical: Top-down view of a square rug: blue-striped ticking field, a plain contrasting border, short fringe at the top and bottom edges.

sack.grain.physical: Top-down view of a slumped grain sack: lumpy black wool serge bag with its tied neck flopped to one side, a little spilled grain beside it.

sack.kitbag.physical: Top-down view of a long kitbag: cylindrical blue-striped ticking bag lying on its side, a waxed leather carry strap looped over the top.

screen.projector.physical: Top-down view of the cine projector on a three-legged stand: a boxy cream enamelled iron body with a lens pointing to the bottom.

security.gun_locker.physical: Top-down view of a rifle cabinet: the flat square top of a deep honey bentwood cabinet filling the square with a moulded rim, its back against the top edge, a heavy iron padlock and hasp showing along the bottom edge.

security.turnstile.physical: Top-down view of a turnstile: a round grey sheet steel post at one side with three sheet steel arms fanning out across a narrow lane, a card reader on top.

server.switchboard.physical: Top-down view of the telephone switchboard: a tall honey varnished pine cabinet along the top edge, a shelf of plugs and cords toward the bottom, an operator's stool in front.

shelf.boutique.physical: Top-down view of a mirrored shop shelf two cells wide: slim honey burr elm frame, a cut glass shelf with a few widely spaced objects, decorative moulding along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

shelf.goods.physical: Top-down view of a shallow goods shelf two cells wide: amber varnished pine shelf edge along the bottom, back panel against the top edge, rows of jars, boxes and bundles packed tight.

shelf.pantry.physical: Top-down view of a pantry shelf two cells wide: chestnut stained beech shelf edge along the bottom, rows of white glazed fireclay jars and tied bundles, back against the top edge.

shelf.utility.physical: Top-down view of a small iron shelf: grey sheet steel uprights at the four corners, a slatted top shelf with boxes and coiled cable, back against the top edge.

shelf.warehouse.physical: Top-down view of a heavy shelving unit two cells wide: heavy grey sheet steel uprights at each corner and the middle, the top deck covered with cartons, labels facing the bottom edge.

sink.scullery.physical: Top-down view of a long scullery sink against the top wall: a shallow rectangular white ironstone trough with a drain hole at one end, a bucket and scrubbing brush on the rim.

sink.wash_basin.physical: Top-down view of a wash basin: a round grey sheet steel bowl of water on a square chestnut stained beech stool, a folded rag and a jug beside it.

sink.washstand.physical: Top-down view of a washstand: a grey polished granite top with a round white delftware basin sunk in the middle, a tall ewer at the back edge, a folded towel hanging from the side rail.

sofa.booth.physical: Top-down view of a fixed tavern booth: a long brown cowhide bench seat with a tall padded back along the top edge, honey bentwood end panels at left and right.

sofa.couch.physical: Top-down view of a two-seat settee: blue-striped ticking cushions, a padded back along the top edge, rolled honey bentwood arms at left and right.

sofa.daybed.physical: Top-down view of a long chaise longue: a rose chintz seat with a curved raised end at the left, a short back rail along the top edge, dark brown polished walnut feet.

sofa.grand.physical: Top-down view of a long three-seat chesterfield: black patent leather cushions in a row, a deep back along the top edge, broad tawny burr elm arms at each end.

statue.bust.template: York stone bust on a pedestal [statue.bust]
statue.bust.physical: Top-down view of the bust on a pedestal: a square brown bentwood pedestal topped by a buff york stone head and shoulders, face toward the bottom.

statue.carving.physical: Top-down view of a small honey bentwood carved figure on a squat base: a rough human shape, head at the top.

statue.figure.physical: Top-down view of the statue: a square speckled terrazzo plinth with a grey-veined marble standing figure, head and shoulders central, raised arm reaching to one side.

still.brew_kettle.physical: Top-down view of a brew kettle: a large round dark green enamelled iron kettle with a steaming open top, set into a buff scrubbed sandstone firebox, a ladle hooked on the rim.

still.pot.physical: Top-down view of a pot still: a round grey sheet steel pot with a domed top, a cast iron pipe coiling into a cooling bucket beside it, a jug under the spout.

still.vat.physical: Top-down view of a fermenting vat: a wide round honey bentwood vat bound with enamelled iron hoops, a loose lid and a paddle laid across the top.

stool.bar.physical: Top-down view of a tall bar stool: a round tan waxed leather seat over a white enamelled iron footrest ring.

stool.ottoman.physical: Top-down view of a padded ottoman: a square maroon plush velvet top with buttoned tufts and short honey burr elm feet at the corners.

stool.plain.physical: Top-down view of a small wooden stool: a round honey bentwood seat, the tips of its legs just showing.

stove.cookfire.physical: Top-down view of a cooking fire: a ring of grey york stone stones around glowing coals, a round grey sheet steel cauldron in the middle seen from above with a ladle in it, the tripod's three legs reaching out to the corners.

stove.cookstove.physical: Top-down view of a small cookstove: a square dark grey cast iron top with two round hot plates, a stovepipe at the top edge, a firebox door glowing at the bottom.

stove.range.physical: Top-down view of a wide cast-iron range against the top wall: a dark grey cast iron cooktop with four to six round plates or burners, a black cast iron towel rail along the bottom edge, a flue or hood along the back.

table.coffee.physical: Top-down view of a low tea table: a long chestnut stained beech top with a lower shelf showing beneath.

table.dining.physical: Top-down view of a square dining table: a honey bentwood top with a runner down the middle, one leg at each corner.

table.long.physical: Top-down view of a very long banqueting table: a dark brown polished walnut top twice as long as it is wide, a line of serving dishes down the middle.

table.plank.physical: Top-down view of a plain deal table: a rectangular brown bentwood top, twice as wide as it is deep, legs at the corners.

table.round_small.physical: Top-down view of a small round table: a round amber varnished pine top on a single central post.

table.side.physical: Top-down view of a small square occasional table: a grey polished granite top with a bevelled edge, slim dark brown polished walnut legs at the corners.

table.trestle.physical: Top-down view of a long trestle table: three chestnut stained beech boards side by side, resting on X-shaped trestles at each end.

throne.gilded.physical: Top-down view of a richly ornate gilded throne: chased bronze frame with flared arms, a deep purple embroidered velvet seat, a fan-shaped back along the top edge.

throne.state.physical: Top-down view of a grand chair of state: a burgundy damask seat between heavy red-brown varnished mahogany arms, a tall crested back along the top edge.

toilet.chamber_pot.physical: Top-down view of a small round chamber pot: a white ironstone pot with a curled handle on one side, a wooden lid half over it, on bare floor.

toilet.close_stool.physical: Top-down view of a boxy commode: a square mid-brown stained beech chest with a hinged lid along the back edge, a grey flannel cushion on top, a carrying handle on each side.

toilet.water_closet.physical: Top-down view of a water closet: a rounded green majolica bowl with its lid closed, the closed lid a solid deep red varnished mahogany oval filling the bowl, a cistern box on the top wall, a short thick pull chain beside it.

utility.boiler.physical: Top-down view of a coal boiler against the top wall: a round grey sheet steel drum with pipes and valves rising at the back, a small glowing fire door or pilot window at the bottom edge.

utility.ladder.physical: Top-down view of a folded stepladder: two long mid-brown stained beech rails with rungs between them, a paint-spattered top step.

utility.mop_bucket.physical: Top-down view of a metal bucket: a round dark grey cast iron bucket full of murky grey-brown water, a thick rim with a small mid-brown stained beech roller wringer clamped to one side, no mop and no handle.

wardrobe.armoire.physical: Top-down view of a massive armoire two cells wide: dark brown polished walnut top edged with carved moulding and rose-gold polished copper inlay, doors along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.narrow.physical: Top-down view of a slim narrow wardrobe: square mid-brown stained beech top, a single door along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

wardrobe.standard.physical: Top-down view of a wardrobe two cells wide: flat honey bentwood top with a hatbox at one end, double doors with enamelled iron handles along the bottom edge, back against the top edge.

workbench.cutting_table.physical: Top-down view of a tailor's bench: a smooth honey varnished pine top with a length of navy wool serge spread across it, shears, chalk and pins, a rack of bolts along the top edge.

workbench.joiner.physical: Top-down view of a cabinetmaker's bench: a heavy honey varnished pine top with a row of bench-dog holes, a cast iron screw vise at the right end, a shelf of planes and chisels along the top edge.

workbench.master.physical: Top-down view of a long guild workbench: a broad red-brown varnished mahogany top with two vises, a brass rule set into the near edge, rows of small drawers and hung tools along the top edge.

workbench.rough.physical: Top-down view of a packing-crate bench: a long pale crate pine plank top resting on two crate pine supports, a few loose tools and shavings on it, a strip of nails along the top edge.

workbench.welding.physical: Top-down view of a welding bench: a thick dark grey cast iron slab top with clamps and scorch marks, a gas bottle and coiled hose at the top-right corner, a grey-striped ticking spark curtain along the top edge.
